forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (human-review flag). Al Jazeera published a 'tentative deal' on June 15 — one day before the horizon — citing Pakistan-Qatar mediated sessions that produced the framework later formalized as the June 17 Islamabad MOU. The June 15 announcement constitutes TIER1 evidence that active negotiations occurred before EOD June 16, satisfying the 'publicly confirmed held negotiating session' criterion. FLAG: DA notes the Switzerland/Buergenstock session formally opened June 21 (post-horizon); resolution correctness depends on whether the June 15 Al Jazeera report documented a qualifying session preceding the formal MOU signing. Escalated for human review.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Iran and Oman jointly announce a Strait of Hormuz commercial transit framework before EOD 2026-09-07?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (human-review flag). Oman FM Badr al-Busaidi traveled to Tehran Aug 25-26 and, jointly with FM Araghchi, issued a bilateral communiqué simultaneously published on Oman MFA official website (fm.gov.om/en/53722/) and Iranian state channels. The communiqué establishes 'a joint temporary navigational corridor through the Strait of Hormuz,' 'a joint project to clear the Strait of mines,' and 'a joint working group between the two foreign ministries.' Bloomberg (TIER1, Aug 25) and Al Jazeera (TIER1, Aug 26) independently confirm. Joint communiqué from both ministries simultaneously, specifying Hormuz transit conditions, meets the resolution criteria. FLAG: Human reviewer should confirm whether 'joint temporary navigational corridor' with ongoing technical negotiations constitutes a 'commercial transit framework' per resolution criteria, or whether the phased/interim nature of the announcement resolves AMBIGUOUS.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Official joint communique published simultaneously by both Oman's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Iran's Foreign Ministry, OR US Secretary of State public confirmation of an Oman-brokered Hormuz transit agreement specifying bilateral Iranian agreement, before EOD 2026-09-07.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Oman FM official press release or TIER1 newswire with confirmed bilateral attribution.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral Omani or Iranian statements without counterpart confirmation do not qualify. Mediator language ('close,' 'progress,' 'encouraging') does not qualify. Must be a concrete, jointly attributed framework announcement specifying transit conditions. A joint communiqué announcing a phased approach with technical negotiations ongoing may resolve AMBIGUOUS if no specific transit conditions (routing, timing, fees) are specified.

forecasts.question: Will the IAEA formally report completion of Iran's down-blending of all >=60%-enriched uranium stocks to <=5% enrichment before EOD 2027-03-01?
forecasts.delta_reason: IAEA verification and monitoring activities in Iran have been suspended since February 28, 2026 (GOV/2026/8). Resolution requires three sequential prerequisites: (1) restoration of IAEA continuous monitoring access, (2) confirmed active downblending under IAEA supervision, (3) IAEA Director General formal completion report — all three remain absent. Iran's 60%-enriched uranium stock was approximately 440.9 kg per the last known IAEA estimate. No downblending under IAEA supervision has been confirmed. The June MOU expired August 17 without a successor framework; no evidence of IAEA access restoration appeared in the Aug 26-28 search window. p revised 0.16 → 0.10 reflecting the additional 11 days of post-MOU evidence confirming all prerequisites remain unmet.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: IAEA Director General report, IAEA Board of Governors formal document, or IAEA Secretariat press statement explicitly confirming full completion — not partial progress — of Iran's down-blending of all near-bomb-grade (>=60% LEU) stocks to <=5% enrichment under IAEA continuous monitoring, published before EOD 2027-03-01.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IAEA.org official publication; TIER1 wire with direct attribution to IAEA DG statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Progress reports, partial-completion milestones, or IAEA access restoration without confirmed full completion do not qualify. A stockpile reduction without completion to <=5% does not qualify. If Iranian nuclear stocks are physically destroyed by military action and IAEA cannot verify compliance, resolve AMBIGUOUS pending IAEA Board assessment.

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz commercial vessel transits reach a 7-day average of >=15 commercial transits/day before EOD 2026-09-21?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast replacing N2 (resolved YES). The Iran-Oman joint communiqué (Aug 25-26) establishes a 'joint temporary navigational corridor' and 'joint mine-clearing project' as the formal basis for Hormuz transit recovery. As of Aug 23, Hormuz recorded 3 commercial transits/day (straits.live) vs. pre-war ~85/day. Reaching a 7-day average of 15/day requires: (1) the temporary corridor to become operationally active, (2) sufficient mine clearance for insurer confidence or naval escort provision, (3) flag-state and shipping industry endorsement of corridor routing. Pakistan back-channel active; Al Jazeera (Aug 25) reported 'significant progress' in Iran-US talks. INTERTANKO legal concerns about Hormuz transit passage rights under UNCLOS remain outstanding and could delay insurer return. p=0.30 reflects the positive framework announcement offset by operational obstacles.

forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Straits.live AIS data confirmed by Lloyd's List, Marine Traffic, or Bloomberg shipping coverage; or IMF PortWatch 7-day average >=15/day recorded and published.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted military convoys do not count toward commercial transit average. Isolated one-day spikes that do not sustain a 7-day rolling average of >=15 do not qualify. If AIS data is unavailable or contradicted by >=20% between sources, resolve AMBIGUOUS pending IMF PortWatch publication.
